viewing_check: Photograph the inside label closely: full model code (AP-?15-N), serial number and country of origin, plus the headstock logo. Check the top for any hairline cracks and bridge lift, neck relief, fret wear, any electronics, and whether back and sides are solid wood or laminate (look at the sound hole edge). Confirm the case is the original and its latches work.
